title: Geo-search box widget
body:
In my opinion this is both a feature request and a bug.

At the moment we cannot use instantsearch.js to make geo-search with an easily defined. Changes Search parameters don't seem effect once mounted properly and changing the latlng wont give me proper results.

Does anyone have a way to use instantsearch that:

1. geocodes a places location
2. adds that as a center on the map
3. Shows results based on \_geoloc

Both versions of instantsearch are effected.

* react-instantsearch
* instantsearch.js
